title: Idea: One-shot music video through the streets of Prishtina
body: A single continuous take starting at sunset, following Kresha from a rooftop down into a crowd. Cinematic, no cuts.
author: sample-fan

title: Idea: Intro track with an old-school film narrator
body: Open the album like a movie: a deep narrator voice setting the scene over strings, then the beat drops.
author: sample-fan

title: Idea: Fan-voted setlist for one tour stop
body: Let fans vote the full setlist for one special show. The Idea Box picks the city.
author: sample-fan
